title: Induced Charge
description: Essential Criteria: The total induced charge on the sheet must be correctly identified as -q.

title: Force Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The force on the charge q must be calculated using the correct formula and values.

title: Work Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The total work required to remove the charge must be computed accurately.

title: Correct Units
description: Optional Criteria: All final answers should include appropriate units for clarity.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Watch for common sign mistakes, particularly in the induced charge and force calculations.
